record.question: Make new sentences as directed: (a) A wounded tiger is very fierce. (change the italic word into adjective clause) (b) Circumstances obliged me to do so. (change the sentence into passive voice) (c) He is poor. He is honest in spite of it. (form a complex sentence using though) (d) 'Give all the help you can.' (form indirect speech) (e) He had many friends. He also had several enemies. (combine the sentences using correct conjunctions) (f) If only I could dance! (Convert into assertive sentence) (g) She says, 'Tea is ready.' (Change to Indirect Speech) (h) The sun is rising in the east. (use the correct form of verb) (i) The man works hard for his living. (write in the future continuous tense) (j) He is greater than I. (change to negative sentence)
